arguments.message: We can accept a bank‑transfer payment, but only for an annual‑term contract. It isn’t a self‑service option – you’ll need to have support set up invoiced billing and issue an invoice before the contract starts. Once that’s arranged, you can send the transfer using the reference we provide and our billing team will apply it. Monthly plans are card‑only, so a bank transfer isn’t possible for those.
